recordSheets.text:
My Record Sheets
Fill these in during the Try It at Home games. Always write the guess before checking.
1. The bean jar — estimate and check (Unit 5)
Try My estimate I counted Was I close?
2. How many bricks long? (Unit 10)
Object My guess Bricks long
3. The coat-hanger balance (Unit 10)
Left bag Right bag Which went down?
4. Cups of water (Unit 18)
Container My guess (cups) Cups it held

selfCheck.text:
My Self-Check
Read each line to him. He ticks a face: green = I can do this, orange = I need to keep trying, red = I can't do
this yet. Go back to the unit for any red face — and try again in a week.
# What can I do? ☺ ☺ ☹
1 I can count up to 20 things, touching each one once.
2 I can read and write numbers up to 20.
3 I can say 1 more and 1 less than a number.
4 I can add by counting on and take away by counting back.
5 I can use the signs +, − and =.
6 I can name circle, triangle, square and rectangle.
7 I can name cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder, cone and pyramid.
8 I can read a pictogram and a block graph.
9 I can sort things in a Venn diagram and a Carroll diagram.
10 I can estimate, then count to check.
11 I can say which of two numbers is larger.
12 I can say that 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones.
13 I can count in tens.
14 I can say the 7 days of the week in order.
15 I can use a balance to find the heavier thing.
16 I can say all the pairs that make 10.
17 I can find half of a shape and half of a group.
18 I can tell odd and even numbers apart.
19 I can say doubles up to double 10.
20 I can read o'clock and half past on a clock.
